The '''1967–68 Copa del Generalísimo''' was the 66th staging of the [[Copa del Rey|Spanish Cup]]. The competition began on 1 October 1967 and ended on 11 July 1968 with the final.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Ferrer |first=Carles Lozano |date=2001-11-16 |title=Spain - Cup 1968 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1968.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260211221344/https://www.rsssf.org/tabless/spancup1968.html |archive-date=2026-02-11 |access-date=2026-03-21 |website=[[RSSSF]]}}</ref>
